image_description: A high-angle, close-up view of a Nile crocodile partially submerged in murky brown water. The image focuses on the dorsal surface of the head and neck, showcasing the rough, armored texture of the skin (scutes). The snout is visible at the bottom center, with nostrils clearly defined. The eyes are positioned dorsally but appear closed or obscured by the angle and lighting. A wooden stick or branch is visible in the upper left background.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: No limbs or feet are visible in the frame.
